The '''''Corellian Queen''''', owned by the [[Nebula Line]] corporation was supposedly the greatest [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==History==
Its exorbitant prices were not the only thing that kept all but the wealthiest beings in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] from buying tickets: people had to prove their exquisite breeding and manners before they could even purchase a ticket on the liner.

[[5 ABY/Legends|Five and a half years]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the ''Corellian Queen'' was taking a break from its regular cruising season, having been replaced by an empty shell that contained a [[Fighter wing/Legends|fighter wing]] led by [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] in an action of the [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|Combined Defense Forces of the New Republic]] [[New Republic Special Operations|Special Operations]] against [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Cronal|Shadowspawn]].
